notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land in hand.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the basic land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
